text:
Type: checked flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a large seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: flat-woven yarn with a handmade texture
Colors: emerald green, lime yellow-green, chocolate brown, black, light grey
Shape: large rectangle with a bold block-check grid of colored rectangles in rows, flat and thin, strong pattern
Feel: lively, bold, warm
Goes with: oak or teak wood, white walls, cream sofas, green plants; Scandinavian, retro or mid-century rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
